W.K.4|K.cc_advanced: I can draw, tell and write a short piece for a clear purpose and explain who it is for.
W.K.4|K.cc_at_target: I can, with help from an adult, draw, tell and write to make a piece that fits my task and purpose.
W.K.4|K.cc_approaching: I can draw a picture and tell an adult about it to share an idea with support.
W.K.4|K.cc_emerging: I can make marks or choose a picture to share an idea with help.

L.K.2.b|K.cc_advanced: I can use un- and -ed to work out new words and tell what they mean.
L.K.2.b|K.cc_at_target: I can use some prefixes and suffixes, like un- and -ed, as clues to what a word means.
L.K.2.b|K.cc_approaching: I can notice un- or -ed at the start or end of a word with help.
L.K.2.b|K.cc_emerging: I can listen to a word and its un- partner (happy, unhappy) and point to the matching picture with help.

L.K.6|K.cc_advanced: I can write a sentence with a capital letter, an end mark and sound-spelled words, and name the punctuation I used.
L.K.6|K.cc_at_target: I can capitalize the first word of a sentence, name common punctuation, spell simple words by their sounds and write letters for most sounds.
L.K.6|K.cc_approaching: I can write the first letter of a sentence as a capital and write letters for some sounds with support.
L.K.6|K.cc_emerging: I can copy letters and point to a period or question mark with help.

RF.1.2.e|1.cc_advanced: I can change sounds in harder words, like blends, to make new words and explain what changed.
RF.1.2.e|1.cc_at_target: I can add, delete or change one sound in a simple one-syllable word to make a new word (cat to bat).
RF.1.2.e|1.cc_approaching: I can change the first sound of a simple word to make a new word with support.
RF.1.2.e|1.cc_emerging: I can say the first sound of a word and hear when it changes with help.

RF.1.3.b|1.cc_emerging: I can blend the sounds of a short CVC word like c-a-t when an adult models it.

RF.3.3.c|3.cc_advanced: I can read long, unfamiliar words by breaking them into syllables and checking that the word makes sense.
RF.3.3.c|3.cc_at_target: I can decode multisyllable words that use all the syllable patterns I have learned.
RF.3.3.c|3.cc_approaching: I can break a two-syllable word into parts and read each part with support.
RF.3.3.c|3.cc_emerging: I can clap the syllables in a spoken word and read short one-syllable words with help.

RF.3.3.e|3.cc_advanced: I can apply the drop-e and doubling rules to new words and explain why I used each rule.
RF.3.3.e|3.cc_at_target: I can drop a final e or double a final consonant correctly when I add an ending (hope, hoping; hop, hopping).
RF.3.3.e|3.cc_approaching: I can add -ing or -ed to a word using a rule chart with support.
RF.3.3.e|3.cc_emerging: I can add -s or -ing to a simple word with help.

W.3.3.b|3.cc_advanced: I can use a variety of transition words and phrases to connect ideas and events smoothly.
W.3.3.b|3.cc_at_target: I can use words and phrases to show event order and link ideas, text and events.
W.3.3.b|3.cc_approaching: I can use first, next and last to order events with a word bank.
W.3.3.b|3.cc_emerging: I can use and or then to join ideas with help.

W.3.3.c|3.cc_advanced: I can choose exact words to add emphasis, contrast or order and explain my choice.
W.3.3.c|3.cc_at_target: I can use familiar words to add emphasis, addition, contrast or order and connect my ideas.
W.3.3.c|3.cc_approaching: I can use also, but or then from a word bank to connect ideas.
W.3.3.c|3.cc_emerging: I can use a few topic words to tell about a picture with help.

L.3.5.d|3.cc_advanced: I can combine ideas into compound sentences on purpose and explain how they help my writing flow.
L.3.5.d|3.cc_at_target: I can write simple and compound sentences and explain why I used each kind.
L.3.5.d|3.cc_approaching: I can join two simple sentences with and, but or so using a frame.
L.3.5.d|3.cc_emerging: I can say or write a simple sentence with a model.

SL.4.1.a|4.cc_emerging: I can bring a picture or note to a discussion and share one idea with support.

R.5.2|5.cc_advanced: I can write a clear summary that explains how several key details work together to develop a theme or central idea.
R.5.2|5.cc_at_target: I can summarize a text and determine its theme or central idea and explain how key details support it.

L.3.1.c|3.ee_at_target: I can identify key words in a text.
